candidates.title: Devin moves Playbooks to Skills
candidates.summary: Devin is replacing Playbooks with Skills, beginning with new accounts on October 24 and an account-by-account migration for existing users.
candidates.what_changed: New accounts created from October 24 start with Skills and no Playbooks. Existing accounts migrate individually; playbooks become skills while preserving their instructions, Playbooks pages become read-only with links to the corresponding skills, and the Playbooks API reads and writes skills so existing automations, @playbook mentions and !playbook macros continue to work.
candidates.why_it_matters: Teams that encoded repeatable coding-agent procedures as Playbooks need to treat Skills as the new durable instruction surface, while validating that API integrations and invocation conventions survive the migration.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Inventory Playbooks, API integrations, @playbook mentions and !playbook macros; migrate new reusable instructions into Skills; then test compatibility as each account migrates. Skills are reusable SKILL.md workflows, and plugins can bundle them with other extensions.

evidence.rationale: Devin's release notes and migration guide document the dated rollout, migration behavior and compatibility promises.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent migration test or audit was identified in the frozen research window.
evidence.claim_scope: The compatibility claims are first-party documentation; this edition does not claim independent verification of every API, macro or account-migration path.

signal.rationale: The change affects the canonical way teams package and invoke repeatable instructions in Devin and may touch existing automation integrations.

learning_gap.existing_explainer_status: The briefing should explain the object-model change and give a short migration checklist inline.

deduplication.canonical_event: Devin announces the October 24 transition from Playbooks to Skills for new accounts and phased migration for existing accounts.
deduplication.previous_coverage: Archive searches found no prior Pulse story using the release-note URL or covering this event, entity and change.
deduplication.material_delta: A dated product migration changes Devin's reusable-instruction primitive while documenting backward-compatibility behavior for APIs and macros.
